shared_elements: boat or ship-like elongated form with row of vertical strokes (A) vs. rows of repeated marks (B) — only loosely comparable
human figure representation (schematic in A, detailed in B)
repeated linear strokes forming a row
justification: A shows schematic, outline-only painted/pecked ship forms with rows of crew strokes stacked in horizontal registers, while B shows two large, richly detailed anthropomorphic figures facing each other, one raising a bowl and the other a fly-whisk, with elaborate hair, beards, garments and inscription bands. The only faint correspondence is the presence of repeated linear strokes in rows and some anthropomorphic content; the depiction conventions (extreme schematism vs. modelled naturalistic profile figures) and the subject matter are otherwise unrelated.
